title: rename_peer params
description: Changes the display name of a known peer.

name.description: New name. An empty or absent name resets it to the fingerprint pseudonym of the key. A name longer than 64 bytes, or with a control, format, line separator or paragraph separator character, such as a line break, a bidirectional control or a zero-width space, fails with invalid_name; the zero-width joiner and non-joiner are allowed.
